result.summary: The page is mostly clean and well-aligned, but one promotional badge displays a nonsensical value. Edge clipping from the horizontal carousel and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card shows a discount badge reading '-0%', which is a meaningless promotion and looks like a failed or unpopulated value.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount is zero or missing, and only render it with a valid positive discount (e.g. '-20%').

issues.description: The search field placeholder text ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on a light gray background, giving it weak contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text so it meets at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the field background.
